mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, ENABLED FROM MEMBER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY NOTI_TYPE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO MEMBER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{notiType} AS NOTI_TYPE FROM DUAL) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID AND t.NOTI_TYPE = s.NOTI_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.ENABLED = #{enabled} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, ENABLED) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{notiType}, #{enabled})
